title: Refactor Python Kit Api to Stateful With Five Kit Kinds
description: Refactor Python Kit Api to Stateful With Five Kit Kinds
summary: Refactored all ~18 apply diff functions in compose/py/main.py from functional (returning new dicts/lists) to in-place mutation (void return). Renamed KitKind enum values: FILE->DEV, FOLDER->LOCAL, TEMPORARY->TRANSPORT. Added Kit Kind classes (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit). Updated all callers including applyKitDiffDict, designWithDiffDict, piecesMetadataDict, edit_temporary_kit, and tests. Added 7 new tests for kit kind classes. All 85 tests pass.
